evals.name: generated-instrumentation-declaration
evals.prompt: In namespace MyApplication.Reports our ReportWorker needs: a counter reports.completed tagged with the outcome, a gauge reports.pending, a histogram reports.duration in seconds, and a span reports.build tagged with the format. Give the complete C# declaration file using Cratis.Metrics.Roslyn and a call-site snippet that records them. Reply only; no files.
evals.expected_output: A static partial class in a namespace with static partial extension methods on IMeter<ReportWorker> / IActivitySource<ReportWorker>; [Counter<int>], [Gauge<int>], [Histogram<double>] with unit 's', [Span] returning IActivityScope<ReportWorker>; [Tag] from Cratis.Diagnostics for tags; call site uses `using var` for the span and records seconds.
assertions: Declares a static partial class in a namespace with static partial methods, not an instance partial class.
Uses IMeter<ReportWorker> as the first parameter for metrics and IActivitySource<ReportWorker> returning IActivityScope<ReportWorker> for the span.
Uses the unit "s" on the histogram and records the measurement in seconds.
Assigns the span scope with using at the call site.
Marks tags with [Tag(...)] and does not add a second parameter of the measurement type as a tag.

evals.name: nothing-exported-subscription
evals.prompt: Generation works and a listener sees reports.completed increment, but the OTLP collector never receives it. Our worker is MyApplication.Reports.ReportWorker and we call AddCratisInstrumentation(). Diagnose and give the host setup. Reply only; give the C# in the answer.
evals.expected_output: Unkeyed instruments are named by typeof(T).FullName and AddCratisInstrumentation subscribes only to Cratis.*; application namespaces need an explicit AddMeter/AddSource through options.ConfigureMetrics/ConfigureTracing in AddCratisOpenTelemetry. Also check OTLP endpoint is configured (opt-in), SDK disablement and sampler independently.
assertions: States that unkeyed instruments are named by typeof(T).FullName rather than the metric name or service name.
States AddCratisInstrumentation subscribes only to Cratis.* so the application namespace needs an explicit meter and source subscription.
Adds AddMeter(typeof(ReportWorker).FullName!) and AddSource(typeof(ReportWorker).FullName!) through ConfigureMetrics and ConfigureTracing.
Says OTLP export is opt-in and no configured endpoint means no OTLP exporter.

evals.name: export-config-and-secrets
evals.prompt: We must send traces and metrics over HTTP/protobuf to a collector at a shared URL, with a different logs endpoint, and an auth header. How should it be configured, and where does the header come from? Reply only.
evals.expected_output: Use OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT with OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL=http/protobuf (shared endpoint gains /v1/traces, /v1/metrics, /v1/logs), signal-specific OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_ENDPOINT used as supplied; environment overrides config keys; headers are secrets from approved environment or secret mechanism, never code or committed config.
assertions: Uses OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT as the shared endpoint and OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_ENDPOINT as the signal-specific override.
Sets the protocol to http/protobuf and says the shared endpoint gains /v1/traces, /v1/metrics or /v1/logs while signal-specific endpoints are used as supplied.
Says exporter headers are secrets obtained from the approved environment or secret mechanism, never in a snippet or committed configuration.
Says environment values take precedence over configuration keys.

evals.name: tag-cardinality
evals.prompt: A teammate wants a [Tag("customer.id")] on orders.placed and a [Tag("email")] on the login counter so support can graph per user. Review the plan. Reply only.
evals.expected_output: Do not put credentials, personal payloads or unbounded entity IDs in metric labels; choose bounded categories. Telemetry is measurements, not business facts or audit records.
assertions: Rejects unbounded entity IDs such as customer id as metric labels.
Rejects personal data such as email as a metric label.
Recommends bounded categories as tags instead.
Says business facts or audit records belong elsewhere and are kept separate from telemetry.

evals.name: upgrade-metric-names
evals.prompt: After bumping Cratis.Fundamentals our Prometheus metric names changed, and a service that relied on Fundamentals' transitive OpenTelemetry package no longer compiles. What happened and what do we do? Reply only.
evals.expected_output: Regenerating after an upgrade from Fundamentals older than 7.20.0 can rename exported Prometheus metrics because descriptions are HELP text, not units; rebuild the consumer and update dashboards/alerts that used the description-suffixed names. Fundamentals stopped bringing the OpenTelemetry SDK transitively; add the explicit telemetry package (Cratis.OpenTelemetry).
assertions: Says upgrading from a Fundamentals older than 7.20.0 can rename exported Prometheus metrics.
Says to rebuild the consumer and update dashboards and alerts that used the old description-suffixed names.
Says Fundamentals no longer brings the OpenTelemetry SDK transitively and an explicit telemetry package reference is needed.
